worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.summary: Teleports with a strange power to trade places with a nearby ally, and makes any enemy watching either of them switch its target along with the swap. Instant and leaves nothing behind; only a partner within range can be chosen.
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.use.0: Trade places with an ally when cornered and send the blow to someone else
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.use.1: Put a low-health self behind the ally
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.use.2: Turn an enemy locked onto you toward your ally
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.description: Trade places with an ally within %1$s blocks; if the swap succeeds, enemies within a %2$s-block radius of the pair's midpoint that are currently targeting either of you retarget to the other.
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.tandem.on: Tandem: swap range ×1.15 and misdirection radius ×1.2, but cooldown ×1.25.
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.tandem.off: Solo: swap range ×0.9 and a smaller misdirection radius, but cooldown ×0.8 — ready to swap often.
worldcombat.skill.allyswitch.timing: Ally move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
On: tandem style, swap range x1.15 and misdirection radius x1.2, but cooldown x1.25 - one long, precise escape. Off: solo style, range x0.9 and narrow misdirection, cooldown x0.8 - swap often.
Consider a swap when a threat is within this distance; larger puts the swap into the choice sooner.
Below this health ratio the companion treats Ally Switch as its top escape; larger swaps earlier, smaller only when nearly down.
On: a hold order no longer stops it from leaving its post to swap.
